home.title: Welcome to teamcheckcheck
home.description: At teamcheckcheck we're more than just a backing platform – we're a community dedicated to empowering poker players worldwide. Whether you're a novice looking to refine your skills or a seasoned player aiming for mastery, our elite coaches from around the globe are here to guide you every step of the way.

coaching.title: Expert Coaching
coaching.description: Our team comprises top-tier coaches with years of experience in Spin & Go poker. They're not just instructors; they're mentors committed to helping you reach your full potential.

potential.title: Unleash Your Potential
potential.description: We believe in unlocking the hidden talents within every player. Our mission is to equip you with the knowledge, strategies, and mindset to excel at the poker table and beyond.

growth.title: No Limits, Only Growth
growth.description: At Teamcheckcheck, we're dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous improvement. We'll never hold you back – instead, we'll empower you to maximize your skill sets and achieve success on your terms.

community.title: Join Our Community Today
community.description: Whether you're aiming for the top ranks or seeking to sharpen your edge, Teamcheckcheck is your ultimate destination for poker excellence. Take the first step towards realizing your true potential and join our vibrant community of poker enthusiasts.

library.title: Extensive Video Library
library.description: Over 1000 videos, with a minimun of 20 nex videos per month

coaching.description: A staking system with 14 levels designated to help players of all abilities succeed.

team.title: TEAM
team.description: XX is a company dedicated to teaching and banking players who are dedicated to POKER in the SPIN AND GO modality.

players.description:
Check Check co-founder.
Uno de los streamers principales de XX.

Hace 10 años que soy profesional del poker y soy co-fundador de la gran familia XX.

Siempre me interesaron los naipes y empecé jugando como todos, con poca experiencia hasta que me dí cuenta de la pasión que tenía por este deporte.

Sí, considero que es un deporte de elite y para estar en lo más alto hay que tener disciplina, sacrificio, responsabilidad y sobre todo estar fuerte de la cabeza para afrontar día a día esta profesión.

Si no lo crees no podés dedicarte al poker.

Es por ello que doy lo mejor de mí para sentarme en la mesa con los mejores.

Mtt en $50-$2100

Check Check co-founder.
.
I have been a poker professional for 15 years and I am co-founder of the great XX family.

I was always interested in mental and strategy games.

I started playing what is called closed poker with friends and when the holdem mode appeared it caught my attention.

In my free time I like to play sports, play paddle tennis, soccer, have dinner with friends, travel and meditate.

What I like most about XX is that we created it from scratch and there are many people who are in the company that I love very much.

My greatest achievement in poker is the financial freedom to be able to do what I want and be able to live doing what I like.

Check Check co-founder.
.
Hace 5 años que soy profesional del poker y soy uno de los co-fundadores de la familia XX.

Desde chico miraba poker con mi papa, me enseñó las reglas, practicábamos sumado a mi gusto por la competencia en cualquier ámbito me llevó a querer descubrir más sobre este juego.

En mis tiempos libre disfruto de estar con amigos, familia, jugar al fútbol, disfrutar de la vida básicamente.

Lo que me gusta de Check Check son todos los momentos vividos desde que comenzó y fuimos creciendo paso a paso todos juntos.

Me guardo en mi corazón cada momento en el que le pusimos cada gota de esfuerzo a este proyecto.

El mayor logro en el poker sin dudas es poder vivir de esta hermosa profesión.

I started playing when I was 19 at university (18 years ago now! How crazy.

I immediately saw that it attracted me and that it could truly become a source of income.

I'm amazed by every aspect of the team, honestly.

The professional team that comprises it is amazing.

How they get involved and make all kinds of tools available to the players, how they are interested in each player's personal situation, and they always individually look for the best spot for each player.

I chose it because I really trust the judgment of Ryan, who was the one who made me the offer, and everyone showed blind faith and confidence in me to join me, so I decided to join with all my will to get the best out of each of the players with those who work.

Today, without a doubt my first goal as a coach is to ensure that as many XX players climb to the highest levels and feel that they are finding their best version.

As a player, continue perfecting my game in spin&go and feel that I continue to improve myself every day, since we never stop learning and that is the beauty of poker.

Check check is the school that trusted me, trained me from initial fees and allowed me to grow in the world of poker by providing me with technical knowledge and behaviors typical of a professional.

3 and a half years have passed since that moment when I decided to dedicate myself fully to this profession.

In my free time, I share moments with my family, my friends and I go to see my club: San Lorenzo.

What I like most about the stable is the meritocracy policy that those who run it preach, since they grant many opportunities to those who are truly committed.

For this reason and because we are always at the forefront of poker to be able to improve, I chose it.

My current goal is to continue improving myself, becoming a better player, coach and streamer day by day, always looking to the highest rates that will be to come.


Coach SPIN in $10s

I have been part of Check Check for two years.

I like poker because it is an exciting game that doesn't allow you to stop learning and improving.

I started playing because I discovered that it is a game of skill and I began to realize that with a few thoughts I could identify what was happening on the table and that it no longer depended on what cards were on the table and what I had in my hand.

The day a friend taught me this I fell in love with poker.

In my free time I like to spend it with my family and friends, traveling and getting to know new places and cultures.

What I like most about CheckCheck is the atmosphere.

From the first to the last, the energy that runs through the company is positive, of helping, motivating, teaching, here no one asks for anything in return and everyone does it with passion and love.

My greatest achievement in life is believing in myself.

Knowing how to dismiss all opinions that went against my objectives, values ​​and beliefs.

Thanks to this I always kept trying, and I continue fighting for my dreams.

Regular 10-25s

Coach SPIN at $0.25 $1 $3s

Soy el Mental Coach de Check Check.

Llevo 4 años como profesional.

El poker es un deporte que me encanta jugar.

La competencia me genera hermosas emociones y grandes desafíos.

A través del coaching y el entrenamiento mental aporto herramientas para la mejora de los jugadores.

Creo que es un área que se trabaja muy poco y considero que el 90% de los resultados depende de nuestras capacidades mentales.

En mis tiempos libres, la verdad son muy pocos, me gusta y disfruto estar con mi familia.

Check Check es el cambio de perspectiva a una actividad que siempre se la vio como marginal en la sociedad.

Profesionalismo, seriedad, proyección, disciplina son conceptos instalados en el póker y XX tiene mucho que ver para que así fuera.

Mi mayor objetivo es colaborar para el crecimiento de este deporte.

Soy el preparador físico de Check Check, hace un año que estoy en la empresa.

Me interesó mucho el mundo del poker ya que no sabía que era un deporte de alto rendimiento y por eso decidí aportar mi conocimiento.

Mi principal objetivo es brindarles a los jugadores, protocolos para que mejoren su SALUD, que tengan su nivel energético a tope y que puedan lograr su mejor versión física.

Elegí trabajar en XX por la calidad de las personas que lo integran.

Desde su cúpula, quieren que logren sus sueños con ellos, que sean mejores jugadores, los capacitan y les dan todo el apoyo necesario para que lo logren.

testimonials.title: Highly recommended
testimonials.description: I started playing al $5 stakes and quicky immersed myself in the game and coaching. Within about 11 months, I was comfortably beating $100 stakes. The knowledge and support from the coaches have been crucial in my progress, backed by hard work. I´ve been with them for
testimonials.author: PATRICIO

testimonials.title: Outstanding
testimonials.description: I chose to join the Check Check poker stable because of its outstanding reputation and supportive environment. The stable provides top-notch coaching, resources, and a community of like-minded players who are all dedicated to improving their game. Being a part of Check Check has significantly boosted my poker skills and confidence. The camaraderie and collective drive for success make it an inspiring place to be. I love being here because it feels like a family where everyone pushes each other to achieve their best, both on and off the table
testimonials.author: MARIANO G.

testimonials.title: Im happy
testimonials.description: Check check is the school that trusted me, trained me from initial fees and allowed me to grow in the world of poker by providing me with technical knowledge and behaviors typical of a professional. I strongly highlight the meritocracy policy proclaimed by those who run the stable since they grant many opportunities to those who are truly committed. THANK YOU for developing me in this discipline that makes me happy!
testimonials.author: JOAQUIN
